title: Lemony Chicken & White Bean Minestrone with Tiny Pasta
summary: Kosher meat dinner: dairy-free chicken and white bean vegetable soup with carrots, celery, zucchini, tomatoes and spinach, served with tiny pareve pasta. About 40 minutes total and 25–30 minutes active; serve components separately for young children.
ingredients: 1½ lb kosher boneless skinless chicken thighs or breasts
1 (15 oz) can cannellini beans, rinsed and drained
¾ cup dry pareve ditalini or small pasta
instructions: Cook the pasta in a separate pot of salted water until tender; drain and reserve.
Heat olive oil in a large soup pot. Sauté onion, carrots and celery for 6–7 minutes. Add garlic, zucchini, oregano and basil and cook 2 minutes.
Add bite-size chicken pieces, tomatoes, beans and broth. Simmer gently for 12–15 minutes, until chicken reaches 165°F and vegetables are tender.
Stir in spinach and simmer 1–2 minutes. Add lemon juice and adjust salt and pepper.
Spoon pasta into bowls and ladle the soup over it. Keep extra pasta separate for leftovers.
child_friendly_modifications: Reserve plain cooked pasta and some mild chicken, soft carrots and beans for separate piles. Serve broth on the side for dipping or sipping; cut chicken into small pieces.
leftovers: Refrigerate soup and pasta separately promptly; use within 3–4 days. Reheat soup to 165°F, then add pasta just before serving.
